what_this_is: Artificial Analysis scores and costs for each model at each thinking level, confirmed by two separate reads: the Artificial Analysis API (aa-data.json) and the public artificialanalysis.ai pages (aa-pages.json). Only rows both agree on are here. Built 2026-10-17T07:29:29Z by .cache/visual-intel/scripts/reconcile.py.
credit: Artificial Analysis (artificialanalysis.ai). Credit it on every exhibit.

definitions.score: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, 0 to 100, higher is better (v4.3.2: ten tests of agents, coding, general knowledge and scientific reasoning). One decimal, from the API; score_on_page is the whole number the public page prints. Chart wording: 'on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, 0 to 100'. Do not quote the category weights: Artificial Analysis's own two pages disagree (25% each v 30/20/20/30).
definitions.cost_usd: What it cost Artificial Analysis to run its full Intelligence Index test set once with this model at this thinking level, in US dollars, at list prices (worked out from the token prices it lists, with its usual cache-hit assumption; not what any customer was billed). Artificial Analysis's chart: 'Cost (USD) to run all evaluations in the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index'. 'At list prices' is our gloss.
definitions.cost_per_task_usd: Artificial Analysis's weighted average cost per test task, in US dollars. The article's dollar figures ($5.98, $0.55, 'about 11 times') are this measure, not cost_usd.
definitions.output_tokens: Tokens the model wrote (its hidden working plus its answers) across the full test set. Exact count from the page's embedded data; the page prints it to two significant figures (output_tokens_on_page).
definitions.thinking_level: How hard the model is set to think: what Anthropic calls effort and OpenAI calls reasoning (Google calls it thinking level). thinking_level_label is Artificial Analysis's name for the setting and is what a chart prints: Non-reasoning (thinking off), Low, Medium, High, Xhigh, Max.
definitions.family: Our grouping of versions of one model line (Claude Opus = Opus 5 and Opus 5.5; GPT Sol = GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol). model is the version; variant is Artificial Analysis's full name for that version at that setting.

how_rows_were_confirmed: Matched by Artificial Analysis slug (the API's data[].slug and the page URL /models/<slug>). Same name, maker, family and thinking level in both.

Score: the API's one-decimal value is within 0.5 of the page's whole number; the page's whole number equals the unrounded page-data value rounded half up; the API value equals that unrounded value to one decimal; the unrounded value is identical in both files; the page's summary card and release-page table cell show the same whole number.
Cost to run the full test set: the API value is within $0.50 of the page's whole-dollar bar label, and equals the page data to the cent.
Cost per task: the API value (4 decimals) is within $0.005 of the page's sentence (2 decimals).
Output tokens: the exact count rounded to two significant figures equals the page's summary card and its sentence ('it generated 260M tokens').
Release date, list prices and the deprecation flag are equal in both.
